article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Kayvaun Mulready had 17 points in Georgetown's 84-53 victory over Navy on Wednesday. Mulready added five rebounds for the Hoyas (5-0). Vincent Iwuchukwu scored 15 points and added nine rebounds. Elmarko Jackson went 6 of 9 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 14 points. Cam Cole led the way for the Midshipmen (4-2) with 13 points and four steals. David Burnett added 10 points and six rebounds for Navy. Justin Nordin finished with seven points and two steals. Georgetown led 40-16 at halftime, with Chol Machot scoring nine points. Georgetown extended its lead to 52-21 during the second half, fueled by a 9-2 scoring run. Georgetown is 4-0 for the first time since the 2017-18 season when it started 8-0. Up next Both teams next play Saturday. Georgetown hosts Coppin State and Navy goes on the road to play Rider. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
